# Suds & Snouts Dog Grooming

> One-to-one, appointment-only dog grooming salon in Liverpool, England. There is no shopfront; the address is shared when you book. One dog in the salon at a time, no cages, and a Quiet Hour for nervous, elderly or reactive dogs.

- Website: https://lukebrennan.github.io/SudsAndSnouts/
- Phone: 0151 496 0123 (+44 151 496 0123)
- Email: hello@sudsandsnouts.com
- Location: Liverpool, Merseyside, England (address shared on booking)
- Areas served: Liverpool and Merseyside
- Booking: online at https://lukebrennan.github.io/SudsAndSnouts/#book or by phone

## Opening hours

- Monday: closed
- Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday: 8:30 to 17:30
- Thursday: 8:30 to 19:30 (walk-in nail clips 17:30 to 19:30, £10)
- Saturday: 9:00 to 16:00
- Sunday: closed

## Grooms and prices (GBP, by dog size: small up to 10kg / medium 10 to 20kg / large 20 to 35kg / XL over 35kg)

- Puppy Splash (pups under 6 months, about 45 minutes): £30 / £30 / £35 / £35
- Wash & Fluff (bath, blow-dry, brush out, nails, ears, hygiene tidy, 1 to 1.5 hours): £35 / £45 / £55 / from £65
- Mini Groom (Wash & Fluff plus face, feet and bum trim, about 1.5 hours): £42 / £50 / £60 / from £70
- Full Groom (Wash & Fluff plus full clip and scissor or teddy trim, 2 to 3 hours): £50 / £60 / £75 / from £90
- Hand stripping (terriers and wire coats): £40 per hour

Extras: teeth brushing £6, blueberry facial £5, pawdicure £8, de-shed £12 to £20, de-matting £10 per 15 minutes (always agreed first), Pup Party bow or nail varnish £5.

## Good to know

- Quiet Hour: the first appointment every Tuesday and Wednesday is kept for nervous, elderly or reactive dogs. If a dog is too stressed the groom stops and owners only pay for work done.
- Suds Club: rebook every 4 to 6 weeks for 10% off every groom plus one free add-on each visit.
- Gift vouchers from £25.
- New clients pay a £10 deposit, taken off the final price. 48 hours' notice is needed to cancel.
- Dogs must be vaccinated and flea-free.
- Breeds groomed often: cockapoos, cavapoos, labradoodles, goldendoodles, shih tzus, bichons, terriers and puppies.
